arithmetic: binary64; ordered builtin sum; (1-alpha)*z + alpha*discount*z_next using preupdate z_next
budget_precedence: test residual at a cap checkpoint; mark target-met if it meets tolerance there, else budget-exhausted
early_stop: a successful full scan may interrupt an episode; no success before every basin state has been updated
mode_ties: negative log probability minus log continuation; STP index, terminal last
representative_ties: exact decimal cost, then cardinality, then increasing node tuple
successor_sampling: one random() draw, cumulative sum, strict draw < cumulative; ascending Boolean strings, dagger last
